title: Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon
subtitle: Another human wakes as a Pokémon

body: Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon is Spike Chunsoft's Nintendo 3DS role-playing adventure about a human transformed into a Pokémon. A chosen partner joins the newcomer through procedurally generated dungeons as a larger crisis threatens their world. The pair begin among the inhabitants of Serene Village before their journey connects them to the Expedition Society. As in the earlier Mystery Dungeon adventures, the Pokémon occupy the roles normally given to human heroes and townspeople. A creature selected for its appearance or abilities becomes somebody with whom the player shares a developing story.

Rooms, corridors, enemies and traps give each expedition a layout to read as it is discovered. Actions proceed in turns, linking the movement of the party to the opportunities available to its opponents. The partner's position matters alongside the controlled character's next move. A useful item or a promising passage therefore belongs to a small tactical situation rather than simply a direction to follow. The shifting arrangement makes preparation valuable while preserving uncertainty: knowing the general rules does not reveal exactly what the pair will find beyond the next corridor.

The game includes the 720 Pokémon released by that point, giving its world an unusually broad cast for the period. The starting choice comes from twenty possibilities, with a partner selected from those remaining. That scale supports the idea of an expedition society bringing different creatures into contact. The central story still depends on the smaller relationship between the newcomer and a partner who also wants a place beyond village life. Super Mystery Dungeon uses a large collection to surround a recognisable shared ambition: leave together, explore and find out what help the world needs.
